response.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT a.frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount * 1.0 ELSE -t.amount * 1.0 END) AS avg_signed, AVG(t.balance * 1.0) AS avg_balance FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY a.frequency), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS mean_signed FROM f) SELECT AVG(f.avg_signed) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(f.avg_balance) AS avg_balance, AVG(f.avg_signed - m.mean_signed) AS avg_excess FROM f CROSS JOIN m WHERE f.avg_signed > m.mean_signed
